findings.title: R12 changes the engine's decision while the extension is DISABLED, and from data the extension itself does not accept

reproduction.setup: runner({id}) with no anchors; weekly reviews through the first week with a QUALITY session; then a MISSED_SESSION review on the day of next week's QUALITY session, that session reported completed:false; the frozen engine alone answers MOVE

observed.extension DISABLED (runCalibrationAuthor: runCalibration.status DISABLED; extended action KEEP; frozen engine MOVE
observed.a FIELD_TEST refused by the extension as: KEEP vs MOVE (refused, yet it still withholds)

findings.expected: With no enabling record the engine's answer is the frozen one (claim 1, contract 'Rules'). The withhold applies only to the documented case: a field test of this athlete accepted into the record, done instead of the week's harder session.
findings.requiredCorrection: Ask for withhold MOVE only when (a) the extension is on (at least CAPACITY enabled by its record), and (b) the replaced session id comes from a FIELD_TEST that is either added by this review (appendEvidence.added) or a readable row of this athlete on the record (readableFact with the inputHash check), and (c) that id is a live QUALITY run session of the plan in force, in the week of the test. Add negative tests for each case above, including DISABLED.

findings.title: Evidence is appended under a review the engine refuses, stamped with that review's own asOf: a backdated or replayed review moves the week in force
findings.where: v1-run-index.mjs line 46 (appendEvidence before any check of the engine's status); evidenceFact declaredAt = review asOf

reproduction.script: qre-v1rc-judge-7f3a/p3b-backdate.mjs (also p3-week.mjs cases e and f)
reproduction.steps: runner with a 10K 55:00 anchor dated 2026-10-11; weekly reviews of weeks 0 and 1; a review on Monday of week 2; then a well-formed review whose asOf is Thursday of week 1 (earlier than the record) declaring a 10K of 50:00 dated Wednesday of week 1; then a review on Thursday of week 2

Also under an engine ASK (eligibility malformed, p3-week f) the declaration is added.

findings.expected: A week's calibration reads only what was on the record before the week started (claim 4). A review the engine does not accept records nothing that can predate the record's own clock.

An offline-queued review synced late is the realistic path. Add a test that kills mutant M03 (a declaration dated before the week, recorded mid-week).

readings.R1: Coherent; the marathon takes the most recent of a STANDARD half and a longer result. No reliability issue found (p8 cases).
readings.R2: Deadband compares each newer result with the held one (no ratchet); works (mutant M10 killed). Order-independent.
readings.R3: Verified: a downward step slows the half/marathon estimate once and the band once (no double application).
readings.R4: Deterministic: executions sorted by date, ties by ledger order. The reliance on o.week (the row's context.weekIndex) to read the band of its own week assumes the plan in force keeps week indices; true for proposals, restarts re-index (they reset factors).
readings.R5: Correct for session rows and declarations, but bypassed by four paths: QRE-V1RC-02, -03, -04, -05.
readings.R6: Works; the engine itself turns a break of 14 days or more into RETURN weeks, which masks the extension's own 14-day rule (M15).
readings.R7: Sporting (EASY may be slower than LONG): SSCTR.
readings.R8: Ambiguous and order-dependent in time: reads evidence not yet in force (QRE-V1RC-04) and non-qualifying results (SSCTR question).
readings.R9: Holds; the marathon gate is killed by tests (M07).
readings.R10: Holds (lab values without protocol, source or units are not shown).
readings.R11: Broken for evidence older than 112 days: QRE-V1RC-06.
readings.R13: Deterministic, but one slow, low-quality entry (MANUAL, no RPE) inside 28 days of a good race removes all capacity (conflict reduction + 2 = 3). Fail-closed direction; a cheap way to switch calibration off. SSCTR question.
